blocks.content: The National Green Tribunal aims to provide effective and speedy disposal of cases relating to environmental protection and conservation of forests and other natural resources.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The primary objective of the National Green Tribunal (NGT) is to ensure effective and speedy disposal of cases relating to environmental protection.
It handles conservation of forests, natural resources, and enforcement of any legal right relating to the environment.
NGT is mandated to dispose of applications and appeals within a period of 6 months from the date of filing.
The Tribunal is guided by the principles of natural justice rather than being bound by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.
NGT is guided by the Principles of Natural Justice and is NOT bound by the procedure under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.
The mandatory endeavor for final disposal of applications or appeals before NGT is within 6 months.
Important exclusion: Laws like the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 and Forest Rights Act, 2006 do not fall under NGT's direct jurisdiction schedule.
